Rooks County Health Services: "Health Care...Close to Home"
Rooks County has health care providers who are committed to health, wellness, and chronic disease prevention.
To locate information on the various health care providers in Rooks County, click on the links below.
Rooks County Health Center
Rooks County Health Center is a Critical Access hospital located in Plainville, serving all of Rooks County and the surrounding area.
www.rookscountyhealthcenter.com
Rooks County Health Department
The Rooks County Health Department provides services including: Immunizations, Blood Pressure Clinics, Women's Health, Child Health Assessments, Blood Draws, Infant Care Programs, and Home Visitation programs.
Rooks County Health Department
Senior Care
Rooks County has Senior Living facilities in both Plainville and Stockton. Redbud Village is located in Plainville and provides nursing home, assisted living, and independent living. The Solomon Valley Manor in Stockton provides nursing home care in a new facility.
Redbud Village
Solomon Valley Manor
Chiropractic care
Restoration Health & Chiropractic has offices in Plainville and Stockton.
Restoration Health & Chiropractic
Dentist
The Stockton Dental Center is located at 624 S. 1st Street.
Stockton Dental Center
Pharmacies
Rooks County has pharmacies in both Plainville and Stockton.
Stockton Pharmacy
Midwest Family Health
Optometrist
Dr. Paul Lampert is an Optometrist and has an office located in Plainville at 200 S. Jefferson. Call 785-434-2074.
Physical Therapy
Rooks County Health Center offers a variety of therapy and rehabilitation services.
